title: Sonnalthan Kaadhala
desc: Roja, a part-time singer, works at a finance company where her colleague, Murali, is madly in love with her. However, Roja rejects his proposal as she is the sole breadwinner of her large family.

title: Pongalo Pongal
desc: Four unemployed graduates are loathed by their parents for their inability to support their families. However, destiny shines upon them after they join hands with a friend and become milk suppliers.

title: Sivasakthi
desc: Sakthi, a police officer, befriends Siva, a smuggler, in order to gain his trust and get evidence against him. But soon, their friendship turns into a genuine one.

title: Vaanchinathan
desc: Vanchinathan, a straightforward policeman, exploits the loopholes in the law to eliminate the criminals who go unpunished.

title: Kizhakku Kadarkarai Salai
desc: Ganesh, a petrol station attendant, is irked by the arrogance of a rich girl. To teach her a lesson, he decides to make her fall for him, but her brother comes up with a devious plan to stop Ganesh.
